node.statement: The root-bound u_delta is the C1 first component supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction. By lem-stage1-explicit-group-domain-membership the same u_delta is defined at every U^dagger, and dagger is real-linear by def-epsilon-cstar-algebra; therefore sigma:U |-> u_delta(U^dagger) is globally C1 on calU. Also u_delta(sJ)=sJ, so sigma(sJ)=sJ.
